extraction.name: BIG-Bench Hard
extraction.description: A subset of 23 challenging BIG-Bench tasks
extraction.creator: Mirac Suzgun, Nathan Scales, Nathanael Schärli, Sebastian Gehrmann, Yi Tay, Hyung Won Chung, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Quoc V. Le, Ed H. Chi, Denny Zhou, Jason Wei
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data collection process involved curating a subset of 23 challenging tasks from the BIG-Bench benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection consists of tasks from the BIG-Bench benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data preprocessing protocol involved filtering out tasks with more than three subtasks, fewer than 103 examples, and tasks without human-rater baselines.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The data annotation protocol involved manually writing chain-of-thought exemplars for each task in BBH.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The data annotation analysis involved evaluating the performance of language models on the curated benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The data release maintenance plan involves versioning information and updating timeframe.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has social implications in terms of evaluating the capabilities and limitations of large language models.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has biases in terms of the tasks and evaluation metrics used.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of data generalization limits and quality issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset use cases include training, testing, validation, and fine-tuning of language models.
